title: Data Dictionary
text: Companhia Metropolitano de São Paulo (.k.. METRÔ) publishes monthly demand reports data transparency portal. Reports cover Lines 1 (Azul/Blue), 2 (Verde/Green), 3 (Vermelha/Red), 5 (Lilás/Lilac, Jul 2018), 15 (Prata/Silver), available October 2017 onward. Values reported thousands (milhares). Three types reports feed package datasets: Passageiros Entrada por Linha — monthly passenger entries line, broken day-type metric. Passageiros Transportados por Linha — monthly passengers transported line, broken day-type metric. Entrada de Passageiros por Estação - Média dos Dias Úteis — average weekday entries per station, per month. Daily station-level data (one row per station per day) available 2020 onward. monthly report breaks demand five day-type metrics: total (monthly aggregate), average business days, average Saturdays, average Sundays, daily peak (maximum within month). Lines 4 (Amarela/Yellow, operated ViaQuatro) 5 (Lilás/Lilac, operated ViaMobilidade August 2018) published METRO portal. Ridership data lines comes Insper Dataverse, starting January 2012 (Line 4) August 2018 (Line 5). Transported counts available Lines 4 5. Unlike METRO data, Dataverse counts rounded nearest thousand. consistency, METRO values multiplied 1,000 ETL datasets report individual passengers. station_averages dataset Lines 4 5 derived station_daily using bizdays package. Specifically, use “Brazil/ANBIMA” calendar, tracks days B3 stock exchange operates São Paulo. closely mirrors city’s business-day schedule; however, since 2022 B3 closes national holidays (municipal state holidays 9th July). precise São Paulo business-day calendar planned future release. Spatial geometries metro commuter train (CPTM) lines stations come GeoSampa, City São Paulo’s open geospatial platform. data includes currently operating infrastructure planned future expansions.

title: Getting Started
text: metrosp package provides access Metro de São Paulo public transportation data. Since data updated regularly datasets rather compact, package distributes data “lazy” format. means data comes prepackaged called directly, without needing download import raw data. four main datasets: passengers_entrance: daily passengers entering metro system passengers_transported: daily passengers transported metro system station_averages: daily average passengers per station station_daily: daily passengers per station convenience, metrosp also provides information stations lines metro system (lines stations). lines dataset spatial dataset requires sf package work properly; carries line numbers Portuguese/English line names full network (including planned CPTM lines). Finally, package also provides named vector colors line metro system (metro_colors). Using datasets straightforward, just call dataset name. datasets returned tibble using dplyr package recommended.
